intelligence.essence: Control determines responsibility. Contracts define guarantees. Independent evidence establishes what occurred. A component cannot convert its own failure into another component's assumption — responsibility follows control, and transferring responsibility requires a proven interface contract. The label DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE tells us nothing; NayaNET must record the causal boundary, not accept the error message as the explanation. No component may move its own obligations into another component's assumptions merely by changing a status, label, interface description or model-checking configuration.
intelligence.falsifier: A scheduler calling its own allocation failure an environment outage and being believed; a worker's unsuccessful executions blamed on the scheduler despite usable service; an environment assumption guaranteeing eventual service and thereby hiding the scheduler fairness defect the checker should find; a qualification that averages a 10/10 progress score against a violated LAW boundary.

human_view.meaning: When something goes wrong, everyone points fingers. This framework makes finger-pointing impossible: every condition has a written-down owner — the component that actually controls it — and that ownership can only change through a proven contract, never by relabeling the error. Three witnesses (environment, scheduler, worker) plus an independent coroner who correlates them. If the witnesses disagree, the verdict is 'undetermined,' not automatic blame. And the killer test: break one component deliberately while the other two behave, then lie about who did it — the system must still name the right culprit from the evidence.

intelligence.learning_lesson: The stack keeps rediscovering the same failure: labels substituting for causality. FAAP attacks it from the assumption side (what was excluded); this attacks it from the responsibility side (who controlled it). Together they close the loop: what happened, who owned it, what was assumed away.

machine_view.spec_only: Framework ratified; spec branch naya5/responsibility-boundary to be built and tested. Not wired into live paths until the integration phases reach it.

intelligence.measurement_contract: Adversarial fault-injection table as executable tests: (1) resource never available -> environment assumption not satisfied; (2) resource available, scheduler never allocates -> scheduler defect; (3) scheduler marks own blocked queue externally ineligible -> responsibility-boundary violation; (4) dispatch without usable resources -> service guarantee failure; (5) usable service, worker loops without progress -> worker progress-on-service failure; (6) worker reports success, outcome absent -> outcome verification failure; (7) worker changes reset fairness counters -> scheduler bookkeeping defect; (8) scheduler works but LAW authorization absent -> legitimate authority block, not starvation; (9) producer guarantee weaker than consumer assumption -> interface mismatch; (10) conflicting logs, no independent resolution -> BOUNDARY_UNDETERMINED. Plus the decisive experiment: Cases A/B/C classified correctly even when the failing component falsely blames another.

naya_view.directive: Attach a versioned responsibility record to every condition in a liveness proof: condition, controller (primary), producer guarantee, consumer assumption, observation boundary, evidence, failure classification, applicable version. Enforce G_producer ⇒ A_consumer at every interface within matching scope, time, versions and environment. Require boundary migration receipts on ownership change; never retroactively absolve. Keep three indicators separate (environment coverage, scheduler fairness, worker progress) plus an interface consistency verdict; never average across dimensions.

simple_view.meaning: Everyone owns what they control, and the paperwork proves it. You can't blame the other guy by renaming your failure.

intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor inherits the controller-primary discipline, so it classifies failures by evidence of control rather than by whoever shouted loudest in the logs.
intelligence.uncertainty: Framework ratified; spec not yet built. Interface with FAAP's assumption registry to be settled during build (control_boundary is the join point).
